subject: Request: Temporary billing hold + SLA amnesty for OrbitScale incident
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-05-29T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: OrbitScale - severity window recap and customer asks

Team — forwarding the customer's note and a short incident recap. OrbitScale hit a sustained tail-latency surge in our US-west region between 2026-05-27 21:10 UTC and 2026-05-28 02:45 UTC. They saw repeat 95th/99th latency spikes impacting inference calls for their payment flows.

Customer requested: a) immediate pause on May invoices pending root-cause finish, b) a goodwill credit equal to 25% of May usage, and c) written assurance of new guardrails (burst controls and routing fallback).

I've attached the incident timeline and a snapshot of their consumption for May. My read: OrbitScale is on a self-serve plan but is high-growth and close to hitting Dedicated thresholds. Losing them would be high signal for churn risk.

Next steps I recommend: loop in Ops to confirm cause & mitigations, present a bounded concession proposal to the customer, and get exec approval for a temporary billing hold while we finish RCA.

Attachments: orbit_incident_timeline.pdf; usage_snapshot_may.csv

Marissa
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-05-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Temporary billing hold + SLA amnesty for OrbitScale incident

Aditya / Karthik — opening an approval thread. OrbitScale (DS-4829) escalated after the latency window Marissa summarized. They want an immediate pause on billing for May and a goodwill credit; Marissa recommends the customer to preserve the relationship.

Proposed options (quick):
- Option A (recommended): Approve a 30-day billing hold for May invoice (no invoice issued this billing cycle) + a one-time 15% usage credit applied to the next invoice. Condition: credit only applies if we complete RCA and agree on guardrails within 14 days.
- Option B: No billing hold, 10% usage credit.
- Option C: Billing hold + 25% credit (customer ask) — requires Exec signoff + legal review (prefers not to set this precedent).

Rationales: a short billing hold gives OrbitScale breathing room and reduces churn risk; 15% is material but bounded and encourages them to commit to new guardrails. If we do full 25% that sets a high bar for future incidents.

Attachments: proposed_amnesty_terms.docx (draft customer note & T&Cs). Please reply with your approval or edit suggestions by EOD tomorrow (2026-05-30 5pm PT). I will notify the customer after signoff.

Thanks — Soojin
Head of Customer Escalations | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-30T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary billing hold + SLA amnesty for OrbitScale incident

Soojin — I reviewed Marissa's timeline and the usage snapshot. Approve Option A with a minor modification: cap the total concession to $60k not to exceed 20% of May consumption value (whichever is lower). Tie approval to three deliverables from the Ops/Eng team: 1) RCA summary within 7 days, 2) mitigation checklist deployed to production within 14 days, and 3) a routing/burst policy shipped to the Dedicated routing plane within 30 days or a documented roll-back plan.

Please include language that the billing hold is temporary and invoices will be reissued if any of the three deliverables are not completed on schedule. Also get Legal to sign off on the customer-facing terms quickly.

I authorize the finance hold and one-off credit under those constraints. If we get pushback from OrbitScale asking for the 25% credit, escalate back to me with estimated financial exposure.

Aditya
COO | Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Santos <maria@orbitscale.com>, Alan Chu <alan@orbitscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-30T17:08:00-07:00
Subject: OrbitScale: temporary billing hold and proposed one-time credit (per our conversation)

Maria / Alan — following up from our call this morning. Thank you for the candid feedback and for working with our team while we finalize the RCA. We understand the business impact and want to reduce friction while we complete our remediation.

What Redwood will do (approved internally):
- Place a temporary billing hold for OrbitScale's May invoice; we will not issue the May invoice while the hold is active.
- Apply a one-time credit capped at $60,000 and limited to 20% of May consumption value (whichever is lower). The credit will be applied to your next invoice after we complete the RCA and confirm mitigations.

Conditions and timeline:
1) We will deliver an RCA summary within 7 days (target: 2026-06-06).
2) We will deploy mitigation steps and a mitigation checklist within 14 days.
3) We will deliver routing/burst guardrails or a documented roll-back plan within 30 days.

If any of the deliverables are not complete on schedule we will reissue the May invoice and the credit/hold will be rescinded; this is to keep the remediation process accountable.

Attached: incident timeline and a short draft of the customer-facing terms for the billing hold and credit. Please review and confirm if this matches your expectations; if you accept, we'll run the legal doc signature and finalize the hold.

Attachments: orbit_incident_timeline.pdf; proposed_amnesty_terms.docx

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Head of Customer Escalations | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142
